title: Squirrel Simulation
description: Calculate the minimum distance for a squirrel to collect all nuts, accounting for the first nut picked.
pseudocode:
1. total_dist = 0
2. max_diff = -infinity
3. for nut in nuts:
4.   dist_to_nut = abs(nut[0]-tree[0]) + abs(nut[1]-tree[1])
5.   total_dist += dist_to_nut * 2
6.   dist_to_squirrel = abs(nut[0]-squirrel[0]) + abs(nut[1]-squirrel[1])
7.   max_diff = max(max_diff, dist_to_nut - dist_to_squirrel)
8. return total_dist - max_diff

steps.note: Calculate distance from tree to nut [2,2]
Add round trip distance (4 * 2 = 8) to total
Calculate benefit of starting at this nut vs tree
Return total distance minus the best starting benefit
